parsed.notes: No actual ratio values are disclosed. As of 9/30/2026 the company was not in compliance with the Existing Financial Covenants (net leverage <=3.75x, FCCR >=1.25x); the breach was waived by the November 4, 2026 First Amendment, after which the company states it is in compliance. The amendment relaxed covenants for the Covenant Change Period (7/1/2026 to 1/1/2028): net leverage max steps 4.75x (9/30/26), 6.50x (12/31/26, 3/31/27), 6.00x (6/30/27), 5.00x (9/30/27), 3.75x (12/31/27), 3.25x thereafter; FCCR >=1.25x resumes 9/30/2027; minimum liquidity $20.0M during the Covenant Change Period (reported monthly); minimum EBITDA $29.75M (9/30/26) stepping to $23.0M, $20.0M, $21.5M, $26.5M, then $32.0M. Liquidity and EBITDA limits are in $ millions. The SOFR+3.25% Level 3 pricing tied to net leverage >3.75x is a pricing grid, not a covenant.
